source: drivine4j 8be5e760, written by its own code (VectorGoldenWriter, not committed): only parameter names are normalized, the SQL stores' $_pN to $_cy_vec<N+1>, and the graph engines' $_vector…, $_among… names to $_cy_vec<n> in the order the statement first names them. The query vector's own binding, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], is left out of parameters and named by "vector". The graph engines' 84 answers that write an index name, a label or a property with a quote or a backslash into the CALL between single quotes, or a root label that is no plain identifier into the among MATCH, were then edited by a script to write it escaped, as a Cypher string or a backtick-quoted label (liberation-data/drivine-cypher-spec#217). On store layout 2 (#161), Oracle's vector table is named as layout 2 names its objects, `<graph>_v2_…` for `<graph>_v_…`: that name alone was changed in its answers. The 168 SQL answers of a nearest search by cosine were then edited by a script to leave out a stored embedding of no length, as Neo4j's cosine index does, and the 40 of a search among ids by cosine to leave out such a root (liberation-data/drivine-cypher-spec#160).

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, (2 - (CAST(CAST((c.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector) <=> CAST($_cy_vec1 AS vector))) / 2 AS score
FROM g_node c
WHERE c.labels @> '["Doc"]'
  AND jsonb_typeof((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 3
  AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 3 THEN vector_norm(CAST(CAST((c.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3))) > 0 END
ORDER BY score DESC, c.nid
LIMIT $_cy_vec2

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, c.doc, (2 - VECTOR_DISTANCE(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB)), TO_VECTOR($_cy_vec1), COSINE)) / 2 AS score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (g
    MATCH (c IS node WHERE JSON_EXISTS(c.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Doc")') AND JSON_EXISTS(c.props, '$.embedding') AND VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB))) = 3 AND VECTOR_NORM(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB))) > 0)
    COLUMNS (c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, c.doc)) c
ORDER BY score DESC, c.nid
FETCH FIRST $_cy_vec2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, (2 - (k.distance)) / 2 AS score
        FROM (
SELECT s.nid, CAST(CAST((s.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3)) <=> CAST($_cy_vec1 AS vector(3)) AS distance
FROM g_node s
WHERE s.labels @> '["Doc"]'
  AND jsonb_typeof((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 3
  AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 3 THEN vector_norm(CAST(CAST((s.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3))) > 0 END
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT $_cy_vec2) k
        JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid
        WHERE c.labels @> '["Doc"]'

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, JSON_TRANSFORM(c.props, SET '$.labels' = c.labels, SET '$."__drivine.stamp"' = c.stamp) AS doc, (2 - k.distance) / 2 AS score
FROM (SELECT s.nid, VECTOR_DISTANCE(s.embedding, TO_VECTOR($_cy_vec1), COSINE) AS distance FROM g_v2_Docembedding_f151d66f s WHERE VECTOR_NORM(s.embedding) > 0 ORDER BY distance FETCH APPROX FIRST $_cy_vec2 ROWS ONLY) k
JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid
WHERE INSTR(',' || LTRIM(RTRIM(JSON_SERIALIZE(c.labels), ']'), '[') || ',"', ',"Doc","') > 0
